name: StraitsMicro Pte. Ltd.
india_angle: The company has operations in India and aims to empower companies to create competitive, high-quality semiconductor solutions.
summary: StraitsMicro Pte. Ltd. is a fabless semiconductor company based in Singapore, specializing in the design and development of secure and AI-enabled System-on-Chip (SoC) products for surveillance, smart city, and intelligent edge computing markets. They collaborate with strategic partners across Asia for product development and manufacturing, focusing on delivering globally competitive semiconductor solutions.
